appraisal_events.evidence: mon amie était venue... habiter à Paris sous le même toit que moi, qu'elle avait renoncé à l'idée d'aller faire une croisière, qu'elle avait sa chambre à vingt pas de la mienne... et que chaque soir... elle glissait dans ma bouche sa langue, comme un pain quotidien, comme un aliment nourrissant et ayant le caractère presque sacré
appraisal_events.explanation: The passage narrates Albertine's move into the narrator's household, giving up her own plans to live under his roof, and the routine, quasi-sacred intimacy of their nightly kiss, as its central and sustained positive movement rather than mere reunion.

status_effects.explanation: The nightly intimacy with Albertine, described as nourishing and sacred, gives the narrator sustained realized closeness, the passage's dominant local outcome despite the surrounding melancholy undertones.

Albertine crosses from her own separate life, giving up a planned cruise, into the narrator's household, living under his roof in an intimate part of the apartment; the passage shows this boundary moving clearly in her favor.
